exerciseSets.instruction: Put the following sentences into indirect speech.

items.prompt: He said to her, “You are my friend.”
answers: He said to her she was his friend.
items.answerSentence: He said to her she was his friend.

items.prompt: Johnny said to his mother, “I don’t know how to do this exercise.”
answers: Johnny said to his mother he didn’t know how to do that exercise.
items.answerSentence: Johnny said to his mother he didn’t know how to do that exercise.

items.prompt: “Don’t come back before one o’clock”, advised my brother.
answers: My brother advised me not to come back before one o’clock.
items.answerSentence: My brother advised me not to come back before one o’clock.

items.prompt: “Cook it in butter”, Mrs Brown said to her daughter.
answers: Mrs. Brown told her daughter to cook it in butter.
items.answerSentence: Mrs. Brown told her daughter to cook it in butter.

items.prompt: The pupils said to their teacher, “Please give us better marks.”
answers: The pupils asked their teacher to give them better marks.
items.answerSentence: The pupils asked their teacher to give them better marks.

items.prompt: “Pull as hard as you can”, she said to me.
answers: She told me to pull as hard as I could.
items.answerSentence: She told me to pull as hard as I could.

items.prompt: “Who put salt in my coffee?”, he asked.
answers: He asked who had put salt in his coffee.
items.answerSentence: He asked who had put salt in his coffee.

items.prompt: My friend said, “Are you going to leave tomorrow?”
answers: My friend asked me if I was going to leave the day after.
items.answerSentence: My friend asked me if I was going to leave the day after.

items.prompt: “Have you done your homework?”, said my mother.
answers: My mother asked me if I had done my homework.
items.answerSentence: My mother asked me if I had done my homework.

items.prompt: I asked Bill, “What time did you go to bed last night?”
answers: I asked Bill what time he had gone to bed the night before.
items.answerSentence: I asked Bill what time he had gone to bed the night before.

items.prompt: Paul said “I must go home now.”
answers: Paul said that he had to go home then.
items.answerSentence: Paul said that he had to go home then.

items.prompt: “There’s been an accident and the road is blocked”, said the policeman. 181
answers: The policeman said that there had been an accident and the road was blocked.
items.answerSentence: The policeman said that there had been an accident and the road was blocked.

items.prompt: “We are waiting for the school bus”, said the children.
answers: The children said that they were waiting for the school bus.
items.answerSentence: The children said that they were waiting for the school bus.

items.prompt: Mary said, “My father died a year ago.”
answers: Mary said that her father had died a year before.
items.answerSentence: Mary said that her father had died a year before.

items.prompt: “Must you go now?”, said Mr. Brown.
answers: Mr. Brown asked me if I had to go then.
items.answerSentence: Mr. Brown asked me if I had to go then.

items.prompt: “Whose bicycle did you borrow yesterday?”, his mother asked him.
answers: His mother asked him whose bicycle he had borrowed the day before.
items.answerSentence: His mother asked him whose bicycle he had borrowed the day before.

items.prompt: “It isn’t so foggy today as it was yesterday”, said the teacher.
answers: The teacher said that it wasn’t so foggy that day as it had been the day before.
items.answerSentence: The teacher said that it wasn’t so foggy that day as it had been the day before.

items.prompt: “Be modest if you are a good pupil”, said my father.
answers: My father told me to be modest if I was a good pupil.
items.answerSentence: My father told me to be modest if I was a good pupil.

items.prompt: “Shut the door but don’t lock it”, she said to us.
answers: She told us to shut the door but not to lock it.
items.answerSentence: She told us to shut the door but not to lock it.

items.prompt: Tom said, “New York is bigger than London.”
answers: Tom said that New York is/was bigger than London.
items.answerSentence: Tom said that New York is/was bigger than London.

items.prompt: “Please help US,” they said to us.
answers: They begged us to help them.
items.answerSentence: They begged us to help them.

items.prompt: “Don’t forget to send your parents my regards”, she said to me.
answers: She told me not to forget to send my parents her regards./ She reminded me to send my parents
items.answerSentence: She told me not to forget to send my parents her regards./ She reminded me to send my parents

answers: The traveller asked me how long it took to get to London.
items.answerSentence: The traveller asked me how long it took to get to London.

items.prompt: John said, “I have finished studying my lesson.”
answers: John said that he had finished studying his lesson.
items.answerSentence: John said that he had finished studying his lesson.

answers: Mary said to John she couldn’t go to the movies with him.
items.answerSentence: Mary said to John she couldn’t go to the movies with him.

answers: He asked me why I hadn’t come to class the day before.
items.answerSentence: He asked me why I hadn’t come to class the day before.

items.prompt: “Did you phone me yesterday?” Tom asked Mary.
answers: Tom asked Mary if she had phoned him the day before.
items.answerSentence: Tom asked Mary if she had phoned him the day before.

items.prompt: “Do you like it?” - “Yes”.
answers: He asked me if I liked it and I said that I did.
items.answerSentence: He asked me if I liked it and I said that I did.

items.prompt: “I didn’t know them. Did you, Tom?” she asked.
answers: She said to Tom she hadn’t known them and asked him if he had known them.
items.answerSentence: She said to Tom she hadn’t known them and asked him if he had known them.

items.prompt: “Avoid the Marble Arch” said the policeman “There’s going to be a big demonstration here.”
answers: The policeman told everybody to avoid the Marble Arch because there was going to be a big

answers: Handing me a bottle of pills, the doctor told me not to take more than two of those at once.
items.answerSentence: Handing me a bottle of pills, the doctor told me not to take more than two of those at once.

items.prompt: They said to me, “Let’s go to the zoo.”
answers: They asked me to go to the zoo./ They suggested going to the zoo.
items.answerSentence: They asked me to go to the zoo./ They suggested going to the zoo.

items.prompt: “I shouldn’t do that if I were you. Isn’t it very dangerous?” He said.
answers: He said that he shouldn’t do that if he were me because it was very dangerous.
items.answerSentence: He said that he shouldn’t do that if he were me because it was very dangerous.

items.prompt: “When we’ve finished this game we’ll have supper.” They said to me.
answers: They told me when they had finished that game they would have supper.
items.answerSentence: They told me when they had finished that game they would have supper.

items.prompt: “Have you got any shampoo, Alice. I must wash my hair.” Johny asked.
answers: Johny said that she had to wash her hair and asked Alice if she had got any shampoo.
items.answerSentence: Johny said that she had to wash her hair and asked Alice if she had got any shampoo.

items.prompt: He said to me “Listen! Can you hear someone coming?”
answers: He told me to listen and asked me if I heard someone coming.
items.answerSentence: He told me to listen and asked me if I heard someone coming.

items.prompt: “Do as I tell you or you’ll be punished. I’ll teach you who is master in this house”, he said.
answers: He asked me to do as he told me or I would be punished and said that he would teach me who
items.answerSentence: He asked me to do as he told me or I would be punished and said that he would teach me who

items.prompt: “When you have cleaned the sitting room, will you please light the fire there? It’s rather chilly today”, my mother said to me.
answers: My mother said that it was rather chilly that day and asked me to light the fire there when I had
items.answerSentence: My mother said that it was rather chilly that day and asked me to light the fire there when I had

answers: Mary said to her friend she would expect to see him the following Wednesday.
items.answerSentence: Mary said to her friend she would expect to see him the following Wednesday.

items.prompt: The teacher asked “Which book are you taking, John?”
answers: The teacher asked John which book he was taking.
items.answerSentence: The teacher asked John which book he was taking.

items.prompt: I asked the policeman “Do you know how far it is to the station?”
answers: I asked the policeman if he knew how far it was to the station.
items.answerSentence: I asked the policeman if he knew how far it was to the station.

items.prompt: “What a dirty face you have!” Ann said to her son.
answers: Ann exclaimed what a dirty face her son had.
items.answerSentence: Ann exclaimed what a dirty face her son had.

items.prompt: “Don’t you know how to behave? There must be no talking in lessons”. The teacher told his pupils.
answers: The teacher asked his pupils whether they knew how to behave and remarked that there must be

items.prompt: “I wonder who is coming on the excursion tomorrow. I do hope it won’t rain.” She said.

items.answerSentence: She wondered who was coming on the excursion the next day and hoped it wouldn’t rain.

items.prompt: “Do as you are told. You are a naughty boy.” Mrs Brown said.
answers: Mrs. Brown told him to do as he was told and complained that he was a naughty boy.
items.answerSentence: Mrs. Brown told him to do as he was told and complained that he was a naughty boy.

items.prompt: “It’s a very nice evening. Why don’t we go for a walk?” Jim suggested.
answers: Jim said that it was a very nice evening and suggested having a walk.
items.answerSentence: Jim said that it was a very nice evening and suggested having a walk.

items.prompt: “You must decide what you want to do”, she said to her daughter.
answers: She asked/ urged her daughter to decide what she wanted to do.
items.answerSentence: She asked/ urged her daughter to decide what she wanted to do.

items.prompt: Mary asked me “Can you tell me why you are so sad?”
answers: Mary asked me if I could tell her why I was so sad./ Mary asked me to tell her why...
items.answerSentence: Mary asked me if I could tell her why I was so sad./ Mary asked me to tell her why...

items.prompt: Jane said to John “Who will come to the movies with me?”
answers: Jane asked John who would come to the movies with her.

items.answerSentence: Jane asked her friend to find out when he last wrote to her.

lessons.title: Tân ngữ chủ động => chủ ngữ bị động
lessons.titleVn: Tân ngữ chủ động => chủ ngữ bị động

blocks.text: Lấy tân ngữ của câu chủ động làm chủ ngữ của câu bị động.

blocks.en: My father built the house.

blocks.text:  The house was built by my father. - Nếu động từ chủ động có hai tân ngữ thì một trong hai tân ngữ có thể dùng làm chủ ngữ trong câu bị động. Tuy nhiên tân ngữ về người được sử dụng nhiều hơn.

blocks.en: I’m writing her a letter.

blocks.text:  She is being written a letter.  A letter is being written to her.

lessons.title: Động từ bị động
lessons.titleVn: Động từ bị động

blocks.text: - Nếu động từ chủ động ở thì simple present hoặc simple past thì động từ trong câu bị động sẽ là:

blocks.en: John delivers the newspapers every morning.

blocks.text:  The newspapers are delivered by John every morning. My mother wrote that letter.  That letter was written by my mother. - Nếu động từ chủ động ở thì present continuous hoặc past continuous thì động từ trong câu bị động sẽ là: 184 HAVE, HAS

blocks.label: Cấu trúc
blocks.text: + BEEN + PAST PARTICIPLE
HAD CAN, MAY,... + BE + PAST PARTICIPLE

blocks.en: He is asking me a lot of questions.

blocks.text:  I am being asked a lot of questions. She was doing her homework at that time.  Her homework was being done at that time. - Nếu động từ chủ động ở thì present perfect hoặc past perfect thì động từ trong câu bị động sẽ là:

blocks.en: My mother has made that cake.

blocks.text:  That cake has been made by my mother. They had prepared a dinner before we came.  A dinner had been prepared before we came. - Nếu động từ chủ động dùng với các động từ như can, may, must, will, shall, have to, used to, ... thì động từ trong câu sẽ là:

blocks.en: My friend can answer this question.

blocks.text:  This question can be answered by my friend. The manager should sign these contracts today.  These contracts should be signed by the manager today.

lessons.title: Chủ ngữ chủ động => BY + tân ngữ bị động
lessons.titleVn: Chủ ngữ chủ động => BY + tân ngữ bị động

blocks.en: My mother made this cake.  This cake was made by my mother.

blocks.text: - Me, you, him, them, people, someone, ... thường được bỏ trong câu bị động nếu không muốn nêu rõ tác nhân.

blocks.en: Someone has sent me the flowers.  I have been sent the flowers.

blocks.text: - Nếu tân ngữ trong câu bị động chỉ sự vật, sự việc thì ta dùng giới từ with thay by trước tân ngữ ấy.

blocks.en: Smoke filled the room.The room was filled with smoke.

lessons.title: Vị trí của trạng từ hoặc trạng ngữ trong câu bị động.
lessons.titleVn: Vị trí của trạng từ hoặc trạng ngữ trong câu bị động.

blocks.text: - Trạng từ/ trạng ngữ chỉ nơi chốn đứng trước by + tân ngữ bị động.

blocks.en: The police found him in the forest.

blocks.text:  He was found in the forest by the police. - Trạng từ/ trạng ngữ chỉ thời gian đứng sau by + tân ngữ bị động.

blocks.en: My parents are going to buy a car tomorrow.

blocks.text:  A car is going to be bought by my parents tomorrow. - Trạng từ chỉ thể cách (adverbs of manner) thường đứng giữa be và quá khứ phân từ.

blocks.en: The scientists have studied the problem carefully.

blocks.text: The problem has been carefully studied by the scientists. 185 Active : Subject + HAVE + object (person) + bare-infinitive + object Passive : Subject + HAVE + object (thing) + past participle (+ by + object (person)) Active : Subject + GET + object (person) + to infinitive + object (thing) Passive : Subject + GET + object (thing) + past participle (+ by + obj. (person)) Active : Subject + verb + object + bare infinitive/ V-ing + ... Passive : Subject + be + past participle + to infinitive/ V-ing +... Active : Passive: Subject + verb + (that) + clause (S2 + V2 + O2...) It + be + verb (past participle) S2 + be + verb (past participle) + (that) + clause + to infinitive... + to have + past participle Active : Verb + object + adjunct. Passive : Let + object + be + past participle + adjunct. ■ Một số dạng câu bị động:

lessons.title: Thể sai khiến (Causative form): HAVE, GET
lessons.titleVn: Thể sai khiến (Causative form): HAVE, GET

blocks.en: I had him repair my bicycle yesterday.

blocks.text:  I had my bicycle repaired yesterday.

blocks.en: I get her to make some coffee.

blocks.text:  I get some coffee made.

lessons.title: Động từ chỉ giác quan (Verbs of perception): see, watch, hear, look, taste, …
lessons.titleVn: Động từ chỉ giác quan (Verbs of perception): see, watch, hear, look, taste, …

blocks.text: a. Câu hỏi có - không (Yes - No questions): là loại câu hỏi mà câu trả lời là có (yes) hoặc không (no). - Đối với động từ đặc biệt như be, have, can, may, must, ... chỉ cần đảo động từ ra trước chủ ngữ.

blocks.text: Can your father speak English? - Yes, he can./ No, he can’t. - Đối với những động từ thường như go, drink, run,... ta cần phải mượn trợ động từ to do để đặt câu hỏi.
